effect_zh: 消灭 1 个被抑制或被压制的单位。
effect_source: Destroy a Suppressed or Pinned unit.

effect_zh: 敌方单位攻击时，加入 1 张“游击队员”，使其成为攻击目标。
effect_source: When an enemy unit attacks, add a SISSI as defender.

effect_zh: 将 1 个“游击队员”加入支援阵线。抽 1 张牌。下个友方回合结束时，将其弃掉。
effect_source: Add a SISSI to your support line. Draw a card. Discard it at the end of your next turn.

effect_zh: 使 1 个单位获得伏击和冲击，且：“被敌方指向或攻击时，敌方随机弃 1 张牌。”
effect_source: Give a unit Ambush, Shock and: "Enemy discards a random card when they target or attack this unit."

effect_zh: 将 1 个敌方单位返回手牌。将 1 张被收缴的复制加入友方手牌。
effect_source: Send target enemy unit to hand. Add a Salvaged copy to your hand.

effect_zh: 敌方单位攻击时，随机将攻击伤害转移至 1 个其他敌方目标。
effect_source: When an enemy unit attacks, its attack damage goes to a random other enemy.

effect_zh: 将 1 个“游击队员”加入 1 个友方单位相邻处。使其具有闪击和收缴。
effect_source: Add a SISSI adjacent to a friendly unit. It has Blitz and Salvage.

effect_zh: 友方总部受到伤害时，将 1 个“游击队员”加入支援阵线。使其获得同等的攻击力和防御力。
effect_source: When your HQ receives damage, add a SISSI to your support line. Give it +X+X where X is the damage dealt.

effect_zh: 使所有友方单位获得 +1 防御力和 -1 行动花费。
effect_source: Your units get +1 defense and -1 operation cost.

effect_zh: 造成 2 点伤害。敌方随机弃 1 张牌。友方回合结束时，弃掉此牌。
effect_source: Deal 2 damage. The enemy discards a card. Discard at the end of your turn.

effect_zh: 消灭 1 个单位。将 1 张此单位的复制加入手中。
effect_source: Destroy target unit. Add a copy of it to your hand.

effect_zh: 将 2 个“游击队员”加入支援阵线。使所有友方“游击队员”获得：“敌方指向或攻击本单位时，+1 花费。”
effect_source: Add two SISSI units to the support line. Your SISSI get: "It costs the enemy +1 kredits to target or attack this unit."

effect_zh: 抽 4 张牌。下个友方回合结束时，将其弃掉。
effect_source: Draw 4 cards. Discard them at the end of your next turn.

effect_zh: 将 1 个“游击队员”加入支援阵线，使所有友方“游击队员”获得 +3 防御力。
effect_source: Add a SISSI to your support line, then give all your SISSI units +3 defense.

effect_zh: 选择并弃 1 张单位以抽 1 张牌。若是被收缴单位，获得 4 个指挥点。
effect_source: Choose and discard a unit to draw a card. Gain 4 kredits if the unit was Salvaged.

effect_zh: 友方总部受到伤害时，改为由敌方总部承受。
effect_source: When your HQ is to take damage, the enemy HQ takes the damage instead.

effect_zh: 敌方单位部署时，将其抑制，然后将 1 个“游击队员”加入支援阵线。
effect_source: When the enemy deploys a unit, suppress it, then add a SISSI to your support line.

effect_zh: 压制 1 个单位。将 1 个“游击队员”加入支援阵线。
effect_source: Pin target unit. Add a SISSI to your support line.

effect_zh: 对 1 个单位和其他同名单位造成 2 点伤害。
effect_source: Deal 2 damage to a unit and each other unit with the same name.

effect_zh: 抑制所有敌方单位。将 1 个具有闪击的“游击队员”加入支援阵线。
effect_source: Suppress all enemy units. Add a SISSI to your support line with Blitz.
